title: Canvas Assignment Weekly Lead Time Trend
dataSources: Canvas assignments (`canvas:assignment`), Khan Academy SAT practice (`khan:sat`), Family Link usage (`familylink:usage`), and OurHome chores (`ourhome:chore`).
app: Canvas LMS exports, Khan Academy SAT practice, Google Family Link screen-time data, and OurHome chore tracking streamed to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=canvas:assignment lead_time_hours=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(lead_time_hours) as avg_duration, max(lead_time_hours) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst lead time for Canvas assignment events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture lead_time_hours on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average lead time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether Canvas assignment tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
